import ee, math
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

def make_roi():
    # Damietta branch mouth near Ras El-Bar, Egypt
    pt = ee.Geometry.Point([31.83, 31.51])
    return pt.buffer(10000).bounds()  # ~10 km radius square area

# Scaling and cloud masking for Landsat L2 SR
def prep_l2(img, sensor):
    qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL')
    # Mask: keep pixels where these bits are 0 (good)
    mask = (qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)  # Dilated cloud
            .And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))  # Cirrus
            .And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))  # Cloud
            .And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))  # Cloud shadow
            .And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0))) # Snow
    scale = 0.0000275
    offset = -0.2
    sr = img.select([b for b in img.bandNames().getInfo() if b.startswith('SR_B')]).multiply(scale).add(offset)
    if sensor == 'LT05':
        red = sr.select('SR_B3')
        nir = sr.select('SR_B4')
    else:  # LC08/LC09
        red = sr.select('SR_B4')
        nir = sr.select('SR_B5')
    out = ee.Image.cat([nir.rename('nir'), red.rename('red')]).updateMask(mask)
    return out.copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start'])

def get_collection_for_year(year, roi):
    year = int(year)
    start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year,1,1)
    end   = ee.Date.fromYMD(year,12,31)
    col = ee.ImageCollection([])
    counts = {}
    if year <= 2012:
        col5 = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2')
                .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end)
                .map(lambda i: prep_l2(i, 'LT05')))
        col = col.merge(col5)
        counts['LT05'] = col5.size()
    else:
        col8 = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
                .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end)
                .map(lambda i: prep_l2(i, 'LC08')))
        col9 = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')
                .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end)
                .map(lambda i: prep_l2(i, 'LC09')))
        col = col.merge(col8).merge(col9)
        counts['LC08'] = col8.size()
        counts['LC09'] = col9.size()
    return col, counts

def fallback_collection(year, roi):
    # widen window by ±6 months
    start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year-1,7,1)
    end   = ee.Date.fromYMD(year+1,6,30)
    col = ee.ImageCollection([])
    if year <= 2012:
        col = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2')
               .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end)
               .map(lambda i: prep_l2(i, 'LT05')))
    else:
        col8 = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
               .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end)
               .map(lambda i: prep_l2(i, 'LC08')))
        col9 = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')
               .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end)
               .map(lambda i: prep_l2(i, 'LC09')))
        col = col.merge(col8).merge(col9)
    return col

def summarize_year(year, roi):
    col, counts = get_collection_for_year(year, roi)
    sizes = {k: counts[k].getInfo() for k in counts}
    total_size = col.size().getInfo()
    if total_size == 0:
        col_fb = fallback_collection(year, roi)
        total_size = col_fb.size().getInfo()
        if total_size == 0:
            print(f"{year} Images: 0")
            return {'code':'C1'}
        else:
            col = col_fb
            print(f"{year} Images (fallback): {total_size}")
    else:
        joined = ", ".join([f"{k}:{sizes[k]}" for k in sizes])
        print(f"{year} Images: {total_size} ({joined})")
    # Composite
    comp = col.median().clip(roi)
    ndvi = comp.normalizedDifference(['nir','red']).rename('ndvi')
    # Valid area (non-null NDVI after masking)
    pixel_area = ee.Image.pixelArea()
    valid_mask = ndvi.mask().And(ee.Image(1))  # ensure image
    valid_area = pixel_area.updateMask(valid_mask).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('area')
    valid_area = valid_area.getInfo()
    if (valid_area is None) or (valid_area <= 0):
        print(f"{year} Valid area km2: 0.00 (0.0%)")
        return {'code':'C2'}
    # ROI total area
    roi_area = pixel_area.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('area').getInfo()
    valid_pct = 100.0 * valid_area / roi_area if roi_area and roi_area>0 else None
    # Vegetation area (NDVI > 0.3)
    veg = ndvi.gt(0.3)
    veg_area = pixel_area.updateMask(veg).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('area')
    veg_area = veg_area.getInfo()
    if veg_area is None:
        print(f"{year} Veg area km2: None")
        return {'code':'C3'}
    veg_frac = veg_area / valid_area if valid_area>0 else None
    if (veg_frac is None) or (math.isnan(veg_frac)) or (veg_frac<0) or (veg_frac>1.0001):
        print(f"{year} Veg fraction invalid: {veg_frac}")
        return {'code':'C3'}
    # Also report 1-km pixel counts for validation
    total_pix = ee.Image(1).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('constant').getInfo()
    valid_pix = valid_mask.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('ndvi').getInfo()
    veg_pix = veg.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('ndvi').getInfo()
    cloud_pct = 100.0 * (1.0 - (valid_pix / total_pix)) if total_pix and total_pix>0 else None
    print(f"{year} Valid area km2: {valid_area/1e6:.2f} ({valid_pct:.1f}%), Cloud/Mask %: {cloud_pct:.1f}")
    print(f"{year} Veg cover: {veg_frac*100:.1f}%  [pixels V/T/Veg: {valid_pix}/{total_pix}/{veg_pix}]")
    return {'code':'OK', 'veg_frac':veg_frac}

def main():
    try:
        roi = make_roi()
        # Report ROI area once
        roi_area = ee.Image.pixelArea().reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('area').getInfo()
        print(f"ROI area km2: {roi_area/1e6:.2f}")
        y1 = 1984
        y2 = 2021
        r1 = summarize_year(y1, roi)
        if r1.get('code') != 'OK':
            print(r1['code'])
            print("A" if False else r1['code'])  # placeholder to keep last line tag-only next
            # The above line prints code twice; fix by returning after printing answer tag.
            return
        r2 = summarize_year(y2, roi)
        if r2.get('code') != 'OK':
            print(r2['code'])
            print(r2['code'])
            return
        # Compare
        v1 = r1['veg_frac']; v2 = r2['veg_frac']
        if (v1 is None) or (v2 is None) or (math.isnan(v1)) or (math.isnan(v2)):
            print("C3")
            return
        ans = "A" if v1 > v2 else "B"
        print(ans)
    except Exception as e:
        # Minimal error reporting to keep within 20 lines and final tag only.
        print("D")

# Run
main()

import ee, math
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# Geometry: ~20x20 km square (10 km radius buffer bounds)
def make_roi():
    pt = ee.Geometry.Point([31.83, 31.51])
    return pt.buffer(10000).bounds()

def mask_landsat_l2(img):
    # QA_PIXEL bits: 1=Dilated Cloud, 2=Cirrus (L8/9), 3=Cloud, 4=Cloud Shadow, 5=Snow
    qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL')
    clear = (qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)
             .And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))  # Cirrus (no effect on LT05)
             .And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))
             .And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))
             .And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)))
    return img.updateMask(clear)

def prep_l2(img, sensor):
    # Scale SR for all SR_B* bands (server-side regex)
    scaled = img.select('SR_B.*').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
    if sensor == 'LT05':
        red = scaled.select('SR_B3')
        nir = scaled.select('SR_B4')
    else:  # LC08/LC09
        red = scaled.select('SR_B4')
        nir = scaled.select('SR_B5')
    out = ee.Image.cat([nir.rename('nir'), red.rename('red')])
    return out.copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start'])

def get_collection_for_year(year, roi):
    start = ee.Date.fromYMD(int(year),1,1)
    end   = ee.Date.fromYMD(int(year),12,31)
    if int(year) <= 2012:
        col = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2')
               .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end)
               .map(mask_landsat_l2)
               .map(lambda i: prep_l2(i, 'LT05')))
        return col, {'LT05': col.size()}
    else:
        col8 = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
                .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end)
                .map(mask_landsat_l2)
                .map(lambda i: prep_l2(i, 'LC08')))
        col9 = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')
                .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end)
                .map(mask_landsat_l2)
                .map(lambda i: prep_l2(i, 'LC09')))
        return col8.merge(col9), {'LC08': col8.size(), 'LC09': col9.size()}

def fallback_collection(year, roi):
    start = ee.Date.fromYMD(int(year)-1,7,1)
    end   = ee.Date.fromYMD(int(year)+1,6,30)
    if int(year) <= 2012:
        return (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2')
                .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end)
                .map(mask_landsat_l2)
                .map(lambda i: prep_l2(i, 'LT05')))
    else:
        col8 = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
                .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end)
                .map(mask_landsat_l2)
                .map(lambda i: prep_l2(i, 'LC08')))
        col9 = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')
                .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end)
                .map(mask_landsat_l2)
                .map(lambda i: prep_l2(i, 'LC09')))
        return col8.merge(col9)

def summarize_year(year, roi):
    col, counts = get_collection_for_year(year, roi)
    try:
        sizes = {k: int(counts[k].getInfo()) for k in counts}
        total_size = int(col.size().getInfo())
    except Exception:
        print("D")
        return {'code': 'D'}

    if total_size == 0:
        col_fb = fallback_collection(year, roi)
        total_size_fb = int(col_fb.size().getInfo())
        if total_size_fb == 0:
            print(f"{year} Images: 0")
            return {'code':'C1'}
        col = col_fb
        print(f"{year} Images (fallback): {total_size_fb}")
    else:
        joined = ", ".join([f"{k}:{sizes[k]}" for k in sizes])
        print(f"{year} Images: {total_size} ({joined})")

    comp = col.median().clip(roi)
    ndvi = comp.normalizedDifference(['nir','red']).rename('ndvi')

    pixel_area = ee.Image.pixelArea()
    valid_mask = ndvi.mask()
    valid_area = pixel_area.updateMask(valid_mask).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('area')
    valid_area = valid_area.getInfo() if valid_area is not None else None
    if (valid_area is None) or (valid_area <= 0):
        print(f"{year} Valid area km2: 0.00 (0.0%)")
        return {'code':'C2'}

    roi_area = pixel_area.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('area').getInfo()
    valid_pct = 100.0 * valid_area / roi_area if (roi_area and roi_area > 0) else None

    veg = ndvi.gt(0.3)
    veg_area = pixel_area.updateMask(veg).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('area')
    veg_area = veg_area.getInfo() if veg_area is not None else None
    if veg_area is None:
        print(f"{year} Veg area km2: None")
        return {'code':'C3'}

    veg_frac = veg_area / valid_area if valid_area > 0 else None
    if (veg_frac is None) or (math.isnan(veg_frac)) or (veg_frac < 0) or (veg_frac > 1.0001):
        print(f"{year} Veg fraction invalid: {veg_frac}")
        return {'code':'C3'}

    total_pix = ee.Image.constant(1).rename('one').reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('one').getInfo()
    valid_pix = valid_mask.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('ndvi').getInfo()
    veg_pix = veg.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('ndvi').getInfo()
    cloud_pct = 100.0 * (1.0 - (valid_pix / total_pix)) if (total_pix and total_pix > 0) else None

    print(f"{year} Valid area km2: {valid_area/1e6:.2f} ({valid_pct:.1f}%), Cloud/Mask %: {cloud_pct:.1f}")
    print(f"{year} Veg cover: {veg_frac*100:.1f}%  [pixels V/T/Veg: {valid_pix}/{total_pix}/{veg_pix}]")
    return {'code':'OK', 'veg_frac': veg_frac}

def main():
    try:
        roi = make_roi()
        roi_area = ee.Image.pixelArea().reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('area').getInfo()
        print(f"ROI area km2: {roi_area/1e6:.2f}")

        y1, y2 = 1984, 2021
        r1 = summarize_year(y1, roi)
        if r1.get('code') != 'OK':
            print(r1['code'])
            return
        r2 = summarize_year(y2, roi)
        if r2.get('code') != 'OK':
            print(r2['code'])
            return

        v1, v2 = r1['veg_frac'], r2['veg_frac']
        if (v1 is None) or (v2 is None) or math.isnan(v1) or math.isnan(v2):
            print("C3")
            return

        # A: Yes (1984 > 2021), B: No
        print("A" if v1 > v2 else "B")
    except Exception:
        print("D")

main()
